_comment: Every number the network model uses lives here. Change it here, never in code.

grid._note: Rural 11 kV feeder end. 50 MVA fault level is an ASSUMPTION - confirm with network operator data.

transformer._note: 200 kVA 11/0.4 kV Dyn11 pole-mount. 4% impedance typical for this size.

lv._note: Zero-sequence line parameters approximated as 3x positive sequence for 4-core LV cable.

pv._note: 30 kWp from size_system.py. fault_k = short-circuit current as multiple of rated.

battery._note: 80 kWh, 20 kW grid-forming inverter. Acts as the voltage source when islanded.

load_defaults._note: Loads read from critical_load_list.csv. avg kW = rated_W x qty x duty/100.
